title: Charles W. Greene Museum

services.name: Museum Passes
services.desc: Pass admits two adults and four children for free. Regular admission rates are $6.00 for adults and $4.00 for children ages 4-12. Children under 4 are free. Pass admits up to 6 adults for $8.50 each. Pass is valid mid-April thru mid-October. Tickets for youth (ages 6-17) are $3 each. Ages 5 and under are free. Pass allows half-price admission for up to two adults and four children. Regular admission is $15/person. Pass admits 2 adults for free. Regular admission rates are $12.00 for adults, $10.00 for seniors (62+), $3.00 for children (ages 5-18) and $3.00 for college
